diagnosis: High-grade serous carcinoma of tubal origin

diagnosis: Metastatic adenocarcinoma from the transverse colon
legend: Recurrent tumour identified on endocervical biopsy, with an appearance resembling HPV-associated adenocarcinoma of usual type or endometrioid carcinoma.

diagnosis: Metastatic adenocarcinoma of the transverse colon
legend: Carcinoma cells showing nuclear staining on SATB2 immunohistochemistry, suggestive of colonic origin in the appropriate clinical context.

diagnosis: Urothelial carcinoma of the bladder, involving uterine cervix
legend: Papillary growth of stratified highly atypical cells, involving the endocervix, identified on a biopsy specimen. It is a diagnostic pitfall, imparting a close resemblance to papillary squamous cell carcinoma.
